newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - Gasoline up, gas oil has firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - Gasoline up, gas oil has firmer.

text.p: NWE gasoline rose by $2 on Tuesday and gas oil also showed a firmer tone, while high sulphur fuel oil barges were largely unchanged, dealers said.
Gas oil held a firmer tone with tightening ARA supplies creating some supportive buying interest for barges and steadying cargo premiums to firmer Benchmark gas oil futures.
However, trade was thin with the small contango between July and August futures encouraging sellers to raise offers.
Prompt barges valued July IPE +$1 a tonne fob Rotterdam at the IPE close with July futures last done at $162.75.
